title: Research Firm Calls Anthropic's IPO 'Unprecedented Test of Investor Gullibity'
summary: A CNBC report covers a research firm's criticism of Anthropic's planned IPO, calling it an 'unprecedented test of investor gullibility' and potentially the year's most ridiculous offering. The Hacker News discussion drew 227 points and 192 comments, reflecting skepticism about AI company valuations and hype.
